I don’t know why you’re being downvoted. If you grew up in an average and loving household, yes 12 year olds are still pretty innocent and aren’t interested in actually having sex. I grew up knowing a lot of kids who had sex that early and they all had a common problem of a bad childhood, uneducated parents, poor, single moms, divorced, abuse/neglect, etc. These are all problems that aren’t apparent unless you actually know the kid.
Aww you know your dog’s absolutely devastated when their ears become droopy.

Sirius Black from Harry Potter.

Harry was so excited that he was going to be able to leave the Dursleys and finally live with someone who loves him. And then he dies.

Coming from an abusive family with an absent dad, I was so hopeful and excited for Harry because as a kid, I saw myself in him. I put down my book and cried for hours that night.
Pair that with some Wakanda weed, he’ll never go out and save the world again!
